# Licence expressions accepted for crates linked into the native ai-guard binaries.
# Checked by `cargo run --example third_party_notices -- check|notices --allowed <this file>` (CI and release).
# Line forms: an accepted SPDX expression; `no-expression: NAME VERSION`; `no-text: NAME VERSION`.
# A Cargo.lock change that brings an expression not listed here fails CI: review the new licence
# (copyleft obligations, redistribution, attribution) and add the exact expression in the same change.
# Initial list generated from Cargo.lock on 2026-11-21 (350 crates, all features). Every expression is
# permissive, or offers a permissive alternative joined by OR (the LGPL-2.1-or-later alternatives are
# not relied on). This is a first review by the release lot, not legal advice: maintainers confirm it.
(MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND Unicode-3.0
